### CRPA Characterization Clinic Project {#crpa}

[The Aerospace Corporation / Federal Aviation Administration]{.feature-org}

[Positioner Automation Lead]{.feature-org}

[Python]{.tag} [Raspberry Pi]{.tag} [ESP32]{.tag} [Automation]{.tag} [RF Testing]{.tag} [Vector Network Analyzer]{.tag} [Manual Machining]{.tag} [Anechoic Chamber]{.tag}
:::

::: {.feature-detail}
* Leading the automation of the AntRunner positioner that orients the CRPA to commanded angles inside the anechoic chamber, owning its electrical, software, and mechanical setup.
* Developing the Python control script that drives the positioner's rotors, and deploying it to the AntRunner's ESP32 controller from a Raspberry Pi.
* Machined custom mounting fixtures for mechanical positioning turntables using manual operations, designing the hardware so the Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna may be placed securely inside the anechoic chamber for testing.
* Executed preliminary benchtop RF test and measurement procedures using a Vector Network Analyzer and dual probe antennas to prepare for upcoming element-level and array-level characterization of the CRPA.
* Collaborated with technical liaisons from The Aerospace Corporation and FAA to evaluate key parameters of a GPS CRPA anti-jamming antenna, supporting ongoing research to inform use of CRPAs for commercial aviation safety.
:::
